sorry_details.sorry_reason: The fundamental theorem of calculus for interval integrals with a one-sided limit at an endpoint where the integrand may be singular (logStar is not defined at t=0 since γ(0)=π is on the slit) requires careful MeasureTheory/integration machinery in Mathlib. The proven infrastructure includes: posSlitPlane domain, logStar (branch of log on ℂ\\[0,∞)), argStar ∈ (0,2π) bounds, and hasDerivAt_logStar (antiderivative of 1/z on the slit domain).

statement_repair: The generated informal proof proposed arg_star with range (0,2π) branched along [0,∞). Mathlib's Complex.arg has range (-π,π] and Complex.log is on slitPlane {z : 0 < z.re ∨ z.im ≠ 0} (complement of (-∞,0]). Our domain Ω = ℂ\\[0,∞) is the mirror image. We define logStar z = log(-z) + iπ using the biholomorphism z↦-z from Ω to slitPlane, deriving all properties from Mathlib's existing Complex.log.
